spec.description: Live Claude session state scraped from claude-prometheus-exporter (port 9091 on Pi via Alloy). Shows rate-limit usage, context window, consumption rate, and session cost.
Percentage of the 5-hour token budget consumed.
spec.title: 5h Rate Limit

spec.description: Seconds until the 7-day rate-limit window resets.
spec.title: 7d Resets In

spec.description: Budget used % divided by window elapsed %. 1.0 means on pace; >1.0 means you will exhaust the budget before reset. Most meaningful while a 5h window is active — when the window has already reset (resets_in_secs = 0), the value reflects the prior window's pace.
spec.title: 5h Pace

spec.description: Percentage of the 7-day window that has elapsed.
spec.title: 7d Window Elapsed

spec.description: Context window usage % over the selected time range. Rising trend within a session indicates context accumulation; hitting 90% typically triggers compaction.
spec.title: Context Window Over Time
Idle time required to get back on track

spec.description: Percentage of the 5-hour window that has elapsed.

spec.description: Percentage of the 7-day token budget consumed.
spec.title: 7d Rate Limit

spec.description: Rate limit used % vs time elapsed % over the current 5h window.
spec.title: 5h Rate Limit Trend

spec.description: Rate of token budget consumption per 15 minutes. Above ~5%/15m is above pace for the 5h window.
spec.title: Consumption Rate (per 15m)
